title: 12 Best Barcelona Natural Wine Bars
description: Discover the best natural wine bars in Barcelona for 2026. From iconic Bar Brutal to cozy L'Anima del Vi, find your perfect glass of unfiltered joy. Explore top picks for budget, experience, and overall quality.

places.name: Can Cisa / Bar Brutal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bottle from their extensive natural wine list, especially something obscure, paired with their steak tartare or daily specials.

places.name: L'Anima del Vi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of a lesser-known French natural wine, paired with their artisanal cheese board.

places.name: Gata Mala
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try several glasses of different natural wines, accompanied by their patatas bravas and mini burgers.

places.name: Denassus
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Opt for their tasting menu with wine pairings to fully appreciate the chef's creativity and the sommelier's expertise.

places.name: Bar del Pla
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their bombas (potato croquettes) and truffled goat cheese toast, paired with a lively Penedès sparkling natural wine.

places.name: Bodega Maestrazgo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of pet-nat (pétillant naturel) and their selection of cured meats and olives.

places.name: La Vinya del Senyor
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A robust red natural wine from Priorat, paired with some artisanal cheese, while sitting on their terrace.

places.name: Garage Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their current favorite orange wine by the glass, along with their homemade pickles or a unique paté.

places.name: Els Sortidors del Parlament
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bottle of a regional natural wine (Penedès or Empordà) and a variety of their classic tapas, especially their 'tortilla de patatas'.

places.name: La Campana
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of natural vermouth or a low-intervention local white wine, with some 'boquerones en vinagre' (marinated anchovies).

places.name: Gresca Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous 'Gresca' egg yolk with potato foam and black truffle, paired with an elegant natural white or orange wine.

places.name: Agüelo 013
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Let the owner guide you through their latest wine discoveries, often paired with their excellent tartines or seasonal specials.
